notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
Telnet to port 25 provides a raw SMTP session for manual testing — VRFY, EXPN, EHLO commands sent interactively. Useful for confirming SMTP behavior, testing open relay manually, and exploring commands without Nmap script overhead.

=== SMTP COMMANDS ===
EHLO domain → capability list
VRFY username → check if user exists (often unreliable — returns 252 for everything)
MAIL FROM: → specify sender
RCPT TO: → specify recipient (test open relay: use external domain)
DATA → begin message body
QUIT → close session

=== OPEN RELAY TEST ===
MAIL FROM: attacker@external.com + RCPT TO: victim@other-external.com → if accepted without auth, confirmed open relay.
